name: Best tier call
description: One call on the best tier over the code-built digest, none when the digest is unchanged, the run is at its ceiling or the watch is off; a reply that is not the JSON asked for falls back to the code's findings. Items are routed through Judgment Calls.
advantages: Judges the findings against recent and planned work, so it can say none, order them and propose a recorded edit.
disadvantages: Costs up to 3000 tokens in and 500 out per changed digest, and its judgment is only as good as the digest.

name: Findings only
description: Raises the findings the code computed from the records (at most three, most severe first) with no model call.
disadvantages: Cannot say none when a finding is not worth raising, cannot weigh a finding against the planned work and proposes no edit: the baseline the call has to beat.
